nodes.d: Sovereign public compute — owned by the public, not a company. Apertus was trained here; it's the production serving target too ({cscsServingNote}).

lineage.summary: Public infrastructure, not a company: CSCS is a unit of ETH Zürich, publicly funded. It trained Apertus and is the production serving target.
facts: Swiss National Supercomputing Centre, in Lugano — operated by ETH Zürich, publicly funded.
Apertus was trained on its Alps supercomputer.

nodes.d: Pre-model input screen — content + child-safety via a self-hosted Shieldstral-1.0-3B judge, live in preview and production. Coop runs the same check only as the flag-off fallback. Declines before the message reaches the model.
Human-in-the-loop review — reviewers triage flagged content for edge cases and appeals, closing the loop on the automated classifiers with reviewable logs. Building.

Open-knowledge search over Wikipedia (open public knowledge), Firecrawl (open web search), and OpenAlex (open scholarly index), grounding answers with cited sources. A Google-scale open web index is still the honest gap.
nodes.prov: open knowledge + open web search + scholarly index

nodes.d: Vector retrieval over the AI Potluck catalog — the committed ecosystem index (gap-map categories, exemplar repos, stack narrative) plus documents the team has uploaded to the admin catalog. Only the committed index grounds answers with real project names from the map.

Pattern-A federated retrieval over SyftHub — discovery (hub.search) picks the most relevant data sources for a query, then server-side retrieval + rerank returns cited snippets. Sources stay at their origin; the app never hosts their bytes.
Federated semantic retrieval over the EPFL news publisher endpoint on SyftHub. Paid per-query; returns cited news snippets.
Open document parsing + retrieval over open vector stores — building. File attach is wired but turned off for the alpha; parsing isn't built yet.
